title: High Classification Accuracy Does Not Guarantee a Stable Gene Signature: A Selection-Stability Analysis of a Compact RNA-Seq Cancer Classifier
dataset: TCGA 5 cancers (2928 tumours 20289 genes); CPTAC external (440)
method: 60 resamples; selection frequency + Jaccard + Kuncheva; 75-gene panels
main_findings: 99%+ accuracy yet only 14/75 genes selected in >=80% of resamples; canonical markers least stable; instability from rank noise not redundancy
limitations: Near-ceiling accuracy; no tuning; only 2 importance measures; no SHAP; single-author student paper
gap_remaining: SHAP/explainer comparison; pan-cancer not tumour-vs-normal; no reusable package emphasis
lessons_for_bioxplain: Directly demonstrates our core premise (accuracy != stability). Use chance-corrected metrics; report stable-core-only performance

title: Discovery of sparse, reliable omic biomarkers with Stabl
authors: Hedou J; Maric I; Bellan G; et al.
method: Noise injection (permutation/knockoff) + data-driven reliability threshold on stability selection
main_findings: Sparser and more reliable biomarker sets than lasso/EN at similar predictive performance
limitations: Method is its own selector - not a post-hoc explainer of arbitrary models; no pathway module
gap_remaining: Comparing explanations across arbitrary model families
lessons_for_bioxplain: Strong existing baseline for 'reliable sparse signature'; cite and consider as comparator (BSD-3-Clause-Clear licence)
challenges_novelty: YES - stability-aware selection already solved well

title: On the Stability of Feature Selection Algorithms
authors: Nogueira S; Sechidis K; Brown G
method: Axiomatic stability measure Phi with confidence intervals; corrects for chance
main_findings: Defines the recommended chance-corrected stability estimator with variance/CI
limitations: Assumes fixed feature-set size treatment; compare over subsamples of one dataset
lessons_for_bioxplain: USE as primary stability metric (implement ourselves - formula is short); report Jaccard/Kuncheva only as secondary

title: stabm: Stability Measures for Feature Selection
authors: Bommert A; Sun X; Bischl B; Rahnenfuhrer J; Lang M
main_findings: Reference implementation to validate our Python stability functions against
limitations: R only; not linked to explanations
lessons_for_bioxplain: Cross-check numerical output of our Nogueira implementation against stabm (LGPL-3 - do not copy code)

title: Consensus features nested cross-validation
authors: Parvandeh S; Yeh HW; Paulus MP; McKinney BA
method: Consensus of top features across inner folds used as selection criterion (cnCV)
main_findings: Consensus across inner folds gives similar accuracy with less compute/overfit
lessons_for_bioxplain: Prior art for 'consensus across folds' - must cite

title: Outcome signature genes in breast cancer: is there a unique set?
authors: Ein-Dor L; Kela I; Getz G; Givol D; Domany E
method: Analysis of gene-list overlap across studies
main_findings: Overlap between published breast outcome signatures is almost zero; many equally good signatures exist
lessons_for_bioxplain: Foundational motivation: instability of signatures is a 20-year-old known problem

title: The influence of feature selection methods on accuracy, stability and interpretability of molecular signatures
authors: Haury AC; Gestraud P; Vert JP
method: Benchmark of filter/wrapper/embedded selectors on accuracy vs stability
main_findings: Simple t-test filter is competitive and often more stable than complex selectors; ensembles don't help much
lessons_for_bioxplain: IMPORTANT: include a simple univariate baseline in our benchmark
overlap_with_bioxplain: HIGH - same design on breast cancer

title: Robust transcriptomic signatures of Alzheimer's disease progression: validated explainable AI approach
authors: Shafik RA; Afify YM; Badr N; Mounir M
method: XGBoost + TreeSHAP; genes kept if >=80% CV consistency and SHAP >=75th pct; composite score (0.4/0.3/0.3)
validation: 5-fold CV + permutation FDR; no external validation
limitations: Single model; ad hoc composite weights; no external cohort; modest performance
lessons_for_bioxplain: Example of weakly justified composite scoring - avoid inventing weights without justification

title: A systematic evaluation of explainable AI methods for high-dimensional transcriptome-based cancer survival prediction
authors: Zuo Y; Yang S; Zhao W
method: Compares 6 XAI methods on prognostic enrichment / DB consistency / Kuncheva stability
explainability: IG GradientSHAP DeepLIFT DeepSHAP LRP permutation
main_findings: DeepSHAP most stable; permutation importance failed under collinearity (near-zero stability)
gap_remaining: Classical models (LR SVM RF XGB) and tumour-vs-normal
lessons_for_bioxplain: Direct precedent for comparing explainers on stability + bio consistency; predicts permutation importance may be unstable in our data too

title: Consistency of feature attribution in deep learning architectures for multi-omics
method: Weighted Kendall tau of SHAP ranks across seeds/architectures
main_findings: SHAP rankings unstable across architecture and seed
lessons_for_bioxplain: Supports need for repeated-run explanation stability

title: First-Mover Bias in Gradient Boosting Explanations: Mechanism, Detection, and Resolution
authors: Caraker D; Arnold B; Rhoads D
method: Shows sequential residual fitting concentrates SHAP on first-chosen correlated feature; fix = DASH / seed averaging
main_findings: XGBoost SHAP unstable under multicollinearity (rho>=0.7); seed-averaging restores stability
lessons_for_bioxplain: Motivates seed-averaged XGBoost explanations and reporting correlated-gene clusters

title: RobustModelMaker: Coupling Bootstrap Stability Selection with Leakage-Safe Nested Cross-Validation for Scientific Machine Learning
dataset: Ovarian biomarkers (PLCO) + UCI superconductivity + one more
method: Bootstrap stability selection inside nested CV; Jaccard stability
main_findings: Tool for stable selection with leakage safety
limitations: Not gene-expression/biology centred; no explanation comparison; no external cohort
lessons_for_bioxplain: Direct software competitor (Python; MIT). Cannot claim 'first leakage-safe stable pipeline'
overlap_with_bioxplain: HIGH - Python tool with same leakage+stability idea

title: Precision Cancer Classification and Biomarker Identification from mRNA Gene Expression via Dimensionality Reduction and Explainable AI
main_findings: Example of the common 'high accuracy + SHAP top genes' pattern
lessons_for_bioxplain: Represents the genre BioXplain must go beyond

title: Integrating Deep Learning and SHAP for Breast Cancer Classification and Biomarker Discovery Using Gene Expression Data
dataset: Breast cancer expression; external GSE45827 GSE7904 GSE42568
main_findings: Reports near-perfect accuracy; GSE42568 already used as external set in prior SHAP work
limitations: Stability of SHAP genes not clearly assessed (search snippet only)
lessons_for_bioxplain: Shows near-ceiling accuracy on GSE42568 is routine - accuracy will NOT be our contribution

title: Stable feature selection utilizing Graph Convolutional Neural Network and Layer-wise Relevance Propagation for biomarker discovery in breast cancer
method: GCNN+LRP vs other selectors incl. SHAP
main_findings: GCNN+LRP gave most stable gene lists; SHAP-based selection less stable
lessons_for_bioxplain: Evidence that SHAP-selected lists can be less stable

title: Systematic Bias in Genomic Classification Due to Contaminating Non-neoplastic Tissue in Breast Tumor Samples
main_findings: Contaminating normal tissue systematically shifts genomic classifiers
lessons_for_bioxplain: CRITICAL CAVEAT: normal breast is adipose-rich; tumour-vs-normal top genes may reflect tissue composition

title: Combining feature ranking algorithms through rank aggregation / Improving the Reliability of Tree-Based Feature Importance via Consensus Signals / Synthesizing Explainability Across Multiple ML Models for Structured Data
method: Rank aggregation (Borda/RRA/weighted voting) of feature rankings across selectors/models
main_findings: Consensus ranking generally improves robustness of feature importance
limitations: Not omics-specific; scoring choices ad hoc
gap_remaining: Principled + evaluated consensus for gene expression
lessons_for_bioxplain: Do NOT invent a scoring formula: use simple documented aggregates (selection frequency + median rank) and test vs alternatives
verification_level: titles only (NOT read) - must read before citing
